a: Yes, on Android and in your browser. Ads keep it free: a small banner, an ad now and then between levels, and videos you can choose to watch for a reward. The shop sells coin packs and Remove Ads, but every level can be won without paying.

Tap an arrow and it slides off the board, but only if nothing is in its way. Clear every arrow to win. Each arrow you clear can only free others, so a level never becomes impossible. Start with arrows whose path to the edge is already empty. How to play has the rest.

q: What happens when I run out of hearts?
a: You start every level with three hearts, and tapping a blocked arrow costs one. Out of hearts, you can continue once with 100 coins for three hearts, or on Android watch a video for full hearts. Or tap Retry and start the level again. A run with a continue doesn't go on the leaderboard.

600, in 17 worlds from the Meadow to Starlight, harder all the way, with a hard level every 10th. A new obstacle arrives every 20 to 30 levels, each on an easy level built to teach it. Boards come in 49 shapes and grow up to 100 cells a side.

Yes: The Tangled Tower. Prince Arlo and Pip the owl climb the Tower of Worlds to break the Duskweaver's curse, told in 81 painted pages with their own music. A world's pages play over the map when you reach it and when you free its guardian, and you can read the whole storybook here too, chapter by chapter as you unlock them.

The boss of each world, on its last level, from Bramble the hedgehog on level 20 to the Duskweaver on level 500. Arrows that fly out of the top of the board hit the guardian, and the last hit frees it, before the curse clock runs out. Most guardians hold a shield that moves every few hits. The wiki explains every trick.

q: Can I play without installing it?
a: Yes: play Exitwise in your browser, on a computer, a tablet or an iPhone. On Android, get it from Google Play. There is no App Store version yet.

On Android, yes: the levels are on your phone, so you can play on the commute or on a plane. Your results wait on the phone and reach the leaderboards the next time you're online. Rooms, other players' maps and the global ranking need a connection.

q: How do I keep my progress on a new phone, or in the browser?
a: Sign in with Google: tap the VHub button at the top right of the map, or Sign in in Settings, on Android and on vgraphics.gr. Once you are in, that button shows your VHub picture and opens your profile. Your saved game is kept in the cloud, so you can carry on from another phone or in your browser. Without signing in, your progress stays on the device.

q: How do coins and hints work?
a: Every level pays 10 coins, a hard level 30, and a perfect clear 5 more. The daily challenge and other players' maps pay too. Spend coins on hints, a continue or powerups. You get 3 free hints; after that a hint costs 30 coins, or on Android a short video.

q: How do I play with friends?
a: Open Play with friends and create a room: you get a 6-character code. 2 to 8 players join by typing it, scanning the invite's QR code or opening its link, in the app or in the browser. Everyone races on the same boards, and the fastest clear scores the most. More about rooms.

q: How do I delete my data?
a: In Settings, Profile, "Delete my Exitwise data" takes you off the boards and removes your results, stats, cloud save and published maps; your VGraphics name and picture stay. In Settings, "Delete my VGraphics account" removes your account in every VGraphics game. The privacy policy has the details.

q: Do my settings follow me to my other devices?
a: Yes, once you sign in to VHub, the free VGraphics account. Music, sounds, vibration, tap twice to launch and the story pages follow you to every phone and PC you play on, and you can change them from your VHub picture at the top right of this site too. Without an account they stay on the device. How loud the game plays stays with each device.
